title: LG Optimized
description: Small modpack focused on optimizing performance while also adding a few quality of life mods.
body:
This modpack bundles up the most popular optimization mods, focusing on improving performance and the FPS count.

There are also a few vanilla-friendly and quality of life mods that add or rework some game mechanics to improve the singleplayer experience. A few examples are:
- **RightClickHarvest** for harvesting and replanting crops with ease;
- **FallingTree** for cutting down trees faster;
- **Easy Anvils** for better combining of enchanted weapons, tools and books;
  
  and many more.

It also includes **Voxy** (with **Voxy WorldGen**), **Faithful 64x** (with Connected Textures, AppleSkin and Dark Mode UI add-ons) and **BSL Shaders** (with a custom preset) for a better visual experience.

You should be able to join any vanilla servers without any issues, given the server is compatible with the modpack's Minecraft version. Some mods may need to be installed on the server side to work on multiplayer.
